paper: D3QE: Learning Discrete Distribution Discrepancy-aware Quantization Error for Autoregressive-Generated Image Detection (ICCV 2025, arXiv 2510.05891)
training_set_in_paper: Trained on ARForensics train: 100k LlamaGen images vs 100k ImageNet images. Only the official checkpoint (model_epoch_best.pth, Hugging Face Yanran21/D3QE) is evaluated; there is no SynthScope-trained checkpoint. Tables 2 and 3 apply the same checkpoint to GAN and diffusion images.

benchmarks.name: ARForensics (7 autoregressive generators, full test set)

paper_number.note: Paper Table 1: LlamaGen 97.19/99.43, VAR 85.33/95.30, Infinity 62.88/79.39, Janus-Pro 92.28/97.53, RAR 91.69/97.77, Switti 75.31/89.09, Open-MAGVIT2 70.08/85.98. Each subset is 6000 real / 6000 fake, so accuracy equals balanced accuracy.

our_number.note: Official checkpoint through SynthScope: 81.74 acc / 92.22 AP (AUROC 91.91) on all 84,000 images; LlamaGen 97.16/99.58, VAR 84.46/95.16, Infinity 63.06/80.26, Janus-Pro 92.39/97.85, RAR 91.70/97.88, Switti 74.23/88.71, Open-MAGVIT2 69.21/86.12, every generator within 1.1 pt acc (tag d3qe_arforensics, job 264795).

paper_number.note: Paper Table 2 (ProGAN, StyleGAN, StyleGAN2, BigGAN, CycleGAN, StarGAN, GauGAN), the AR-trained checkpoint applied to GANs.

our_number.note: Official checkpoint through SynthScope (bench_eval --dataset cnndetection --select the 7 GANs): 83.45 acc / 92.23 AP (AUROC 90.65); ProGAN 95.10, StyleGAN 76.21, StyleGAN2 75.08, BigGAN 86.07, CycleGAN 83.27, StarGAN 73.64, GauGAN 94.76, every GAN within 1.5 pt (tag d3qe_cnndetection, job 264795).

paper_number.note: Paper Table 3 (ADM, GLIDE, Midjourney, SD-v1.4, SD-v1.5, Wukong): ADM 70.43, GLIDE 88.89, Midjourney 61.21, SD-v1.4 83.33, SD-v1.5 83.37, Wukong 84.43.

our_number.note: Official checkpoint through SynthScope (bench_eval --dataset genimage_full --select the 6 subsets): 79.44 acc / 90.94 AP (AUROC 90.49), the mean within 0.9 pt; per subset the gaps are larger (ADM 63.67, -6.8; GLIDE 91.13; Midjourney 63.80; SD-v1.4 82.21; SD-v1.5 85.10; Wukong 90.73, +6.3), so the paper's GenImage test sample probably differs from ours (tag d3qe_genimage_full, job 264795).
